verdict.rationale: Scheduling is a fair question for an email-sending service, which could offer scheduled or recurring sends, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no SES capability to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Receipt rules that trigger Lambda and event publishing to EventBridge are event-driven or host-platform building blocks, not a recurring schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
